title: BREAKING: Fable 5 is Back #claude #anthropic #ai
description:
Fable 5 is back: Here is what you need to know about the global re-release.

We break down the latest capability upgrades for paid users and analyze why security concerns led to previous tool suspensions. This update covers everything from new usage settings to classifier boundaries that you should be aware of before logging in.

Subscribe for more AI model updates and share your thoughts on the new benchmarks in the comments.
